name: Textbook Format Preference
description: Format used by 126 students vs. a professor's predicted 60/25/15% split. IMS Ch. 16 (goodness-of-fit).
studyDescription: A professor using an open-source statistics textbook predicted that 60% of students would buy a hard copy, 25% would print it from the web, and 15% would read it online. Of 126 students surveyed at the end of the semester, 71 bought a hard copy, 30 printed it, and 25 read it online. The goodness-of-fit test asks whether the predictions were accurate.

variableDescriptions.format: How a student used the textbook: hard copy, printed from the web, or read online.

sourceDetail: OpenIntro / IMS Ch. 16. Observed 71/30/25 vs. predicted 0.60/0.25/0.15. χ² = 2.32, df = 2, p ≈ 0.31 — consistent with the predictions.
